title: CameraDistance 2.2.1: nametag flicker fix test
intro: Reset Scripts first (CameraDistance 2.2.1, TestGuide v1.4). The main pawn near the Arisen. If the camera flies off after you untick, tick it again right away.

steps.text: Do the nametags flicker now? Remember, then press End
Menu > Camera Distance > Couch Co-op Framing: UNTICK 'Restore camera pose before each update'. Close the menu, press End
Watch: is the flicker gone? Is the camera steady (no drifting)?
Controller: run the main pawn around (5-15 m). Camera OK? Press End
If it was better, leave it unticked; if not, tick it again. Press End

probes.rel: local c=sdk.get_primary_camera():call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local a=H.arisen():call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); return string.format('%.2f,%.2f,%.2f', c.x-a.x, c.y-a.y, c.z-a.z)
probes.ascr: local p=H.arisen():call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
